episodes.synopsis: Rookie policewoman Mai Kawai is ready to quit the force when the job turns out to not be what she expected, until the arrival of her new instructor Sergeant Fuji causes her to consider sticking around after all.
episodes.title: Unbox & Punching Bag

episodes.synopsis: Kawai continues to learn from her female colleagues what it takes to be a good police officer. The lessons this time involve domestic incidents, and how to deduce what's not immediately obvious.
episodes.title: Beginner's Luck / Police Jungle

episodes.synopsis: Detective Minamoto makes his presence known, now that the vacuum Sgt. Fuji left behind in Criminal Affairs makes him the division ace. Kawai and Fuji confront various societal issues having to do with the treatment of one's elders.
episodes.title: Enter the Ace / The Corpse's Tale

episodes.synopsis: The chase is the thing! Or so Kawai discovers, when a police dog is brought in to help find a missing old man. Then the chasing continues when the police have traffic control duty during a local marathon.
episodes.title: Dear Dog-Sama / Runner's High

episodes.synopsis: Fuji tries to teach Kawai a lesson about responsibility during their late-night patrol shift. Yamada has his work cut out for him when he finds himself investigating an unrepentant train groper.
episodes.title: Late-Night Patrol / Vs. the Groper

episodes.synopsis: Fuji and Minamoto have more in common than they'd care to admit, particularly their competitive spirits. This can complicate all manner of things, especially when the next police call could come in at any time.
episodes.title: The Roaring Mixer / Runaway Police

episodes.synopsis: The competition gets personal when the team is tasked with chasing a crystal smuggler. By assisting Minamoto with the interrogation of the dealer's lover, Kawai is able to witness unusual methods firsthand.
episodes.title: Tailing Championship / Smooth Talker

episodes.synopsis: It's a horrible day for Kawai for she temporary has to team up with Shikine, an officer who is often over-enthusiastic and overly straight-laced.
episodes.title: Rampage of Justice / Musclehead

episodes.synopsis: The lieutenant decides it's high time he applied more discipline to the station's physical training regimen. Kawai and Fuji spend a night fielding one outrageous police report after another.
episodes.title: Arrest Techniques / UFO

episodes.synopsis: Yamada risks becoming a laughingstock when he commits the cardinal sin of losing his police ID. Kawai must figure out how to deal with one of the more disturbing aspects of being on the force.
episodes.title: Police ID / Trauma

episodes.synopsis: Kawai just wants to go home after a long shift and get some rest, but things don't seem to go according to plan. A witness to an attack on a girl comes along and someone will need to do a composite sketch of her testimony.
episodes.title: Cannabis and Likeness / Sketch Artist Rhapsody

episodes.synopsis: As the investigation of the high school attack case continues, they need to check the facts from the testimonies of the people involved in the case.
episodes.title: Reenactment Doll / First Investigation Division

episodes.synopsis: After Makitaka gets the victim's statement and Minamoto and Fuji spot Yasuda leaving the house, it seems the case is finally over. However, for lack of evidence, they still have to be cautious, which basically takes Kawai and company off the rest of the case.
episodes.title: Decisive Moment / Run Pawn Run
